extension.description: The reusable Titanium X framework: artwork providers (TMDb, fanart.tv, Titanium X Assets repositories, Cinemeta, Motion Engine, disc synthesis), the persistent SQLite artwork database, enrichment, catalog execution (Golden Catalogue / Nuvio packs) and diagnostics. Used by Titanium X Artwork Downloader Pro, the background service and the Titanium X skin widgets. Original code.

extension.summary: Background artwork cache maintenance for Titanium X
extension.description: Keeps the Titanium X artwork cache healthy: enforces the configured storage cap with least-recently-used cleanup and checks the Titanium X Assets manifest for updates. The single background service for the whole Titanium X ecosystem — no duplicate services, no duplicate databases.

extension.summary: Next-generation artwork downloader for dynamic catalogs and libraries
extension.description: Titanium X Artwork Downloader Pro enriches movies and TV shows with up to 33 artwork categories — posters, keyart, character PNGs, disc art, animated artwork and more — without requiring a personal Kodi library. Works with dynamic streaming catalogs, TMDb Helper, Trakt, Nuvio and Golden Catalogue imports, and traditional libraries. Multiple providers, custom artwork repositories, Motion Artwork Studio, persistent SQLite cache. Original Titanium X code.
Installs and updates all original Titanium X add-ons: Artwork Downloader Pro, the artwork service and shared engine, the catalog plugin, Motion and Character studios, and the Titanium X skin.

extension.summary: Install, update, back up and maintain Titanium X
extension.description: The Titanium X Wizard: check for add-on updates from the official Titanium X repository, back up your Titanium X settings and artwork (with an option to exclude API credentials for shared backups), restore backups, and clean the artwork cache. Personal settings and credentials are never deleted without explicit confirmation, and credentials never appear in logs or backup manifests.

extension.summary: Assemble and export your own Titanium X builds
extension.description: Build Creator Pro assembles a Titanium X build definition (base skin, add-ons, collections, artwork packs, theme, performance preset, default views) into a versioned build manifest and exports an installable build ZIP. Credentials are structurally excluded: the manifest has no settings fields and the exporter refuses credential-like files.

Proof of concept: 20 popular movies served dynamically (no Kodi library), each enriched with character art, disc art, keyart, extra fanart, clearlogos and alternate posters, presented in a cinematic Showcase window. Artwork is retrieved by IMDb/TMDb ID from fanart.tv and TMDb and cached locally.

Titanium X flagship skin: four home layouts (Cinema, Netflix style, Disney style, Apple style), animated posters, transparent character artwork, clearlogos, keyart and rotating disc artwork, showcase/wall/wide views, four colour themes and three font sets. Integrates with the Titanium X Artwork Engine, Artwork Downloader Pro, Wizard and Build Creator Pro. Streaming-first: dynamic catalogs, no local library required.
